messages:
Maya: quick design question — I'm prototyping a "preview kill switch" to silence notification sends from the preview pane during maintenance windows. Thinking a tiny toggle on the channel row so QA/devs can test without spamming channels. screenshot: https://figma.redwood/preview-mute-1.png
Arjun: feasible. couple qs: is this per-channel or global? per-channel seems safer. backend needs a `mute_preview` flag on routing config. implementation sketch: add boolean to routePolicy and short-circuit preview delivery unless `persist` is set.
Sam: per-channel 👍. also want to clarify behavior for canary vs global sends — don't want accidental silencing of canary alerts. default should be transient (preview-only) and require an explicit "persist" if you want it stored.
Maya: yeah I was imagining the default = transient (session) and a small "persist" checkbox in the advanced panel. in the channel list the control is just a small speaker/mute icon.
Priya: a11y notes: the icon needs an accessible name e.g., aria-label="Silence preview for <channel>"; toggling must write to a live-region: "Preview muted for <channel>". current contrast for the muted state in the mock fails AA. also ensure focus ring >= 3px and visible on dark themes.
Arjun: noted. implementation details: we'll emit telemetry `preview.mute.toggled` with {channel_id, user_id, persist}. debounce toggles client-side to avoid duplicate API calls. sample payload: ```{ "channel_id": "slack:123", "mute_preview": true, "persist": false }```
Maya: small copy tweak proposal: swap tooltip "Mute" => "Silence preview" (less negative/technical). show a one-time inline confirmation on first use: "Silence previews for this channel during maintenance? [Don't show again]"
Sam: +1 to "Silence preview" — clearer for support folks. also add acceptance criteria: muting preview must never suppress audit/event logs (we still record sends even if blocked) and muting must not change delivery routing unless persist=true.
Priya: keyboard interactions: toggle must be reachable via Tab order before channel settings; activation should support Space and Enter. for screen readers, expose state via aria-pressed and include a visually-hidden status update.
deploy-bot: design doc created: https://redwood.workspaces/docs/preview-mute-v1 (draft)
Maya: thanks! I'll update Figma with the new states + high-contrast color tokens and post revised frames here when ready. tagging @Arjun for API shape :thumbsup:
Arjun: I'll add a backend feature flag and pick up the frontend bits next sprint. please add exact AC to the PR: mute toggles don't delete or suppress audit logs, transient toggles revert on session end unless persist=true, and canary alerts bypass preview mute by default.
Sam: done — AC added to the ticket.
Maya: closing loop — will share final mockups and copy variants in this thread once they're uploaded.
